{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure sentinel)
df_clean = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby("patient_id")["sample_seq"].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Compute the mean baseline biomarker value (already in ng/mL)
mean_baseline = df_dedup["biomarker_baseline"].mean()

print(f'Number of patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}')
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline}')"}
